unwrap_or_default_basic: unwrap an Optional value returning a default when the value is None
unwrap_or_default_string: unwrap an Optional string returning an empty string as the default fallback
unwrap_or_default_int: unwrap an Optional integer returning zero as the default when the value is None
unwrap_or_default_list: unwrap an Optional list returning an empty list as the default fallback value
unwrap_or_default_generic: unwrap any Optional typed value returning a type-safe default when None is passed
